correctness.rationale: Line equations provide 27 lines; elementary pairing equations yield 81 simple and 18 triple crossings. Blowup at all 18 triples gives 45 rational boundary components and 135 nodes, hence dual graph first Betti 91. The 27 line classes span Pic(S) integrally, proving 20 residue classes and vanishing weight-two H2, while rational curves eliminate weight three. Affineness eliminates degrees>2 and integral meridian primitivity proves torsionfree homology. From those 20 integer residue basis vectors, the local exceptional residue sum and iterated wedge-residue rule give a specified 135x235 integer matrix whose ranks modulo101 are exactly 135 (full) and 44 (boundary), proving cup surjectivity over Q. value.rationale: The 2026 positive-geometry study highlights the 27-line complement and computes 109 logarithmic top forms for generic cubic surfaces, but the maximally Eckardt Fermat cubic has an exceptional boundary with eighteen triple points. The specific rank-91 cohomology, pure Tate structure, integral Betti ranks and, especially, degree-one generation of the full rational cohomology algebra distinguish a mathematically natural exceptional member and determine a structural multiplicative invariant not implied by incidence counts or generic logarithmic-form dimension alone.
